If there are any PlayStation Plus gamers out there who want to spend the Christmas break getting good and lost in a massive open world game, I've got a suggestion for you. Now, it's worth pointing out that size isn't everything when it comes to video games. Just because an open world game is big doesn't automatically mean it's worth playing. It just so happens that Black Flag has a big open world and stands as one of the best Assassin's Creed games of all time.

I should stress that we're talking about the original game here and not this year's Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced. If you're gaming on a budget and fancy sailing around as a would-be assassin but don't want to pay for the remake, I can promise you the original version still holds up beautifully. It's also a genuine classic

It may be a familiar game, but it's always worth pointing out that the original Assassin's Creed Black Flag is completely free for PlayStation Plus Extra subscribers. And at a whopping 235 square kilometers, it outstrips Skyrim's own impressive map by roughly 37 square kilometers.

Whether you've played it before or not, the Christmas break could well be the perfect time to dive back into this all-time classic and remind yourself what Ubisoft can do when it's firing on all cylinders.

PlayStation Plus Has A Ton Of Assassin's Creed Games

You're spoiled for choice

If, for some mad reason, you've decided Assassin's Creed Black Flag isn't for you, then there are a bunch of other Assassin's Creed games available to play on PlayStation Plus.
